_doc: PLU-323 guard: superseded route-first trade-lens definitions retained for PLU-274 history/migration only. The retired fan-out generator reads this file; normal /scope-run execution must not use it as the production path. NOT confidential: generic trade scope, no client data.

scope: Non-structural metal/wood stud partition framing per the partition schedule (WA/WC/WD types), including non-rated, rated, and chase partitions
Gypsum board (all variants: Type X, Type C, moisture/mold-, abuse-, impact-resistant, high-strength ceiling board) each face of partitions
GWB ceilings, soffits, bulkheads, and suspended GWB ceiling grids
Shaft-wall and area-separation assemblies
Cementitious backer board as a tile substrate (you furnish/install the board; tile is set on it by the tile trade)
In-wall wood/metal blocking and backing for wall-supported items
GWB finishing, levels 1-5
Control/expansion joints and metal corner/edge trim on GWB
Head-of-wall deflection track/runner, slip framing, and the framed deflection gap at rated/acoustic partitions
excludes: The firestop sealant / fire-resistive joint system itself (firestopping) — you frame and board the assembly and leave the gap; the firestop trade seals it
Final paint, stain, or coatings (painting) — including the coating on plywood backer
Acoustical ceiling tile and grid (acoustical-ceilings)
Setting tile, resilient, wood, or terrazzo finishes on your board (flooring-resilient-tile)
furnishInstallSplits: You SET (and brace/return GWB into) hollow-metal door frames the door supplier FURNISHES
netNewProbes: Head-of-wall safing track at rated partitions
Control/expansion joints (GA-216) in continuous GWB runs >~30 ft
Suspended GWB soffits/bulkheads at RCP transitions
Shaft-wall (C-H stud) at elevator/MEP chases
Metal furring/hat-channel at interior face of exterior/shaft walls

scope: Field-applied paints, stains, and clear/transparent finishes on GWB, wood, and metal
Intumescent / fire-retardant COATINGS (the coating film, applied to a substrate another trade furnishes)
Field paint prep and finish at hollow-metal frames and exposed metal
Painter's caulk at trim/finish joints
Receiving the specified GWB finish level and applying the paint system over it
excludes: The SUBSTRATE being coated — you do NOT furnish the GWB, plywood backer, or millwork you finish; you apply the coating only
Factory/shop-applied finishes (delivered pre-finished)
Wallcovering/wallpaper, unless paperhanging is explicitly assigned to painting
netNewProbes: HM frame field paint prep + finish coats
Intumescent/FRT coatings at exposed structural steel / FRT plywood
Painting of suspended GWB ceilings/soffits
Block filler / sealer at CMU before finish coats

scope: Floor finishes: ceramic/porcelain tile, resilient (LVT/sheet/rubber), wood/engineered, terrazzo, sealed/polished concrete
Ceramic/porcelain WALL tile and its setting materials
Waterproofing membrane, crack-isolation/uncoupling membrane, and tile backer setting bed at wet areas / under tile
Self-leveling underlayment and floor prep for finish flooring
Transition strips, thresholds, tile movement joints, tile edge trim (Schluter, etc.)
Tile base and resilient/rubber base where set by the flooring trade
excludes: The gypsum/cement BOARD substrate itself (drywall furnishes the backer board; you set tile on it)
GWB metal trim, corner guards, and accessories (drywall)
Wood base, casing, and trim (finish-carpentry-millwork)
Sealed-concrete vs painted-floor coating boundary belongs to whoever the spec assigns the coating — claim it only where it is a flooring/sealer finish, not a paint film
netNewProbes: Transition strips/thresholds at flooring-material changes
Crack-isolation/uncoupling membrane (Schluter Ditra) under tile
Self-leveling underlayment over gypcrete/structural floor
Tile movement joints per TCNA EJ171
Waterproofing membrane up walls at wet areas

scope: Door leaves (hollow-metal, wood, specialty) per the door schedule
Hollow-metal and wood door frames (furnish; setting may split to the framer)
Door hardware sets, closers, exit devices, and the keying schedule
Gasketing, smoke seals, and weatherstripping at doors
Frame anchors, grout fill, and silencers
excludes: The GWB returned into the frame cavity (drywall)
Field painting of the frame/leaf (painting)
Storefront/coiling/overhead doors when assigned to glazing/specialty trades
furnishInstallSplits: You FURNISH hollow-metal frames; the framer/drywall trade SETS them
You FURNISH door hardware; install may be by the door/carpentry installer
netNewProbes: Hardware sets + keying schedule (rarely itemized on the door schedule)
Fire-rating labels and smoke gasketing at rated doors
Frame anchors + grout fill at masonry/HM frames
Silencers, thresholds, and astragals

scope: Suspended acoustical ceiling tile (ACT) systems: tile, suspension grid, hangers, perimeter trim
The ACT option of an either/or ACT-vs-GWB ceiling assembly
Specialty acoustical panels/baffles where assigned to the ACT trade
excludes: GWB ceilings, soffits, and bulkheads (drywall)
The GWB option of an either/or ceiling assembly (drywall)
Sound attenuation batts inside partitions (drywall framer) — claim only ceiling-plenum acoustical scope where it is yours
netNewProbes: Seismic bracing/perimeter clips for the ACT grid
Transition trim between ACT and GWB ceilings
Access panels/tiles coordinated with MEP above ACT

scope: Through-penetration firestopping at MEP/sprinkler penetrations of rated walls, floors, and ceilings (per listed UL systems)
Fire-resistive JOINT systems at head-of-wall and at the deck flutes of RATED partitions
Perimeter fire-containment / safing at slab edges and curtain-wall interfaces
Fire-rated and smoke sealants; acoustical sealant where the spec assigns it to the sealant trade
Firestop at smoke-curtain, stair, and shaft assemblies
excludes: The rated partition or floor ASSEMBLY itself — you claim the firestop JOINT/SEALANT at it, NOT the studs/board/framing (that is drywall)
ANY scope at NON-rated assemblies — a non-rated partition has zero firestop scope; do not claim WA0/WC0-type non-rated partitions
The deflection track/runner and head framing (drywall) — you fill/seal the gap, you do not frame it
netNewProbes: Through-penetration firestop at named UL systems for MEP run through rated walls/ceilings
Perimeter safing at slab edge / curtain-wall (named UL)
Firestop at the elevator smoke-curtain and stair-shaft penetrations
Joint sealant schedule (interior/exterior, acoustical, fire)

scope: Architectural millwork and casework (cabinets, vanities, countertops, reception/amenity millwork)
Stained/veneer wood wall paneling and its hanging system (Z-clips, French cleats)
Wood trim, casing, and wood/MDF base
Closet shelving, rod-and-shelf, and storage millwork
Wood door frames at wood-door conditions (boundary with the door supplier)
Blocking specifically required for millwork/casework attachment (coordinated with the framer)
excludes: The backup stud-and-GWB partition behind paneling (drywall)
Final stain/finish if the spec assigns it to painting (claim the fabricate/install; the painter stains) — name the split
Plastic-laminate/solid-surface fabrication when assigned to a separate fabricator
furnishInstallSplits: Wood paneling/casework FURNISHED by millwork; backing/blocking may be INSTALLED by the framer
Wood door frame: boundary with the door supplier — name who furnishes
netNewProbes: Closet shelving and rod-and-shelf (rarely on a schedule)
Window stool/apron and jamb extensions
Countertop/backsplash millwork at vanities and amenity
Z-clip / French-cleat hanger systems for paneling
